summary: A single community post ("Question" about SWDY margins) rendered in full with its author, body, engagement counts, and a flat-with-one-indent-level comment thread beneath it. A glass composer bar is pinned above the bottom nav so the user can add to the thread without leaving the screen.

sections.name: Status bar (shared chrome, overlay)
sections.description: Simulated iOS status bar drawn by the canvas mock, pinned to the top of the phone shell above the scrolling content. In a real Flutter app this is the OS status bar; what matters for the build is that it reserves 54px and that content must not scroll under it visibly (it is pointer-events:none and NOT backed by a blur or fill, so content DOES scroll behind it — the design relies on the 54px top padding of the scroll container to keep content clear).
sections.layout: position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:54px; z-index:6; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; padding:0 26px; pointer-events:none; font:500 13px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#1B1917; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Left child: text "9:41". Right child: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px containing three bars — (a) 16x9px, border-radius:2px, background:#1B1917, opacity:.85; (b) 5x9px, border-radius:1px, background:#1B1917, opacity:.5; (c) 22x10px, border-radius:3px, background:#1B1917, opacity:.85.

sections.name: Scroll container + screen root
sections.description: The single scrolling surface for the whole screen. All non-pinned content lives here. Scrollbars are hidden globally (*::-webkit-scrollbar{width:0;height:0;display:none}). The screen root is a vertical stack whose 18px gap governs the spacing between every top-level block below; the individual blocks add their own internal margins on top of that.
sections.layout: Scroll container (line 53, shared by all screens): position:absolute; inset:0; overflow-y:auto; scrollbar-width:none; padding:54px 16px 124px; box-sizing:border-box. Inside a phone shell of exactly 390x844px, border-radius:46px, overflow:hidden, background:linear-gradient(180deg,#EDE8E2 0%,#E3DCD4 100%). Content column width therefore = 390 - 16 - 16 = 358px. Screen root (line 520): display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:18px; animation:bRise 240ms ease-out. bRise keyframes (line 19): from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px)} to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}.

sections.name: Header action row
sections.description: Back button on the leading edge; bookmark and overflow buttons on the trailing edge. IMPORTANT: on this screen the bookmark and overflow buttons have NO onClick handler and NO state binding — they are static decoration. The identical-looking bookmark button on the Research reader screen (line 569) DOES bind onClick={{p.toggleSave}} style={{p.saveStyle}}; this screen does not. Only the back button is interactive here.
sections.layout:
Row: padding-top:6px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between. (So the row's visual top edge sits 54+6=60px from the top of the 844px shell.)

Back button (onClick={{p.back}}): width:42px; height:42px; border-radius:16px; background:#F7F4F0; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.08); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font:300 20px/1 Outfit,sans-serif; color:#1B1917; cursor:pointer. Glyph: "‹" (U+2039 SINGLE LEFT-POINTING ANGLE QUOTATION MARK).

Trailing group: display:flex; gap:8px.
  Bookmark button: width:42px; height:42px; border-radius:16px; background:#F7F4F0; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.08); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:#1B1917. Child SVG: width=16 height=16 viewBox="0 0 15 15" containing <rect x="3" y="1.5" width="9" height="12" rx="2.4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4"/>. No cursor:pointer, no handler.
  Overflow button: width:42px; height:42px; border-radius:16px; background:#F7F4F0; box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(27,25,23,.08); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font:400 13px/1 Outfit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; color:#1B1917. Glyph: "···" (three U+00B7 MIDDLE DOT). No cursor:pointer, no handler.

Total trailing group width = 42+8+42 = 92px.

sections.name: Post block — kind + ticker chip row
sections.description: Two pills identifying the post type and the company it is filed against. The kind chip is outline-only (ember hairline, no fill); the ticker chip is a solid ink pill and is the only tappable element in this row.
sections.layout:
Row: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px. This row is the first child of the post block <div> and has no top margin, so it is separated from the header row by the root's 18px gap only.

Kind chip ("Question"): padding:5px 11px; border-radius:999px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(232,98,28,.55); font:500 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#E8621C. No background fill. No letter-spacing. Rendered height = 10 + 5 + 5 = 20px.

Ticker chip ("SWDY ›", onClick={{p.goCompany}}): padding:5px 11px; border-radius:999px; background:#1B1917; font:500 10px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.06em; color:#F5F1EC; cursor:pointer. Trailing glyph is "›" (U+203A) preceded by a normal space, inside the same text node.

sections.name: Post block — title
sections.description: The post headline. Single display-weight line of Outfit, wraps naturally; the seed copy wraps to two lines at 358px content width.
sections.layout: margin-top:16px; font:300 30px/1.12 Outfit,sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:#1B1917. Computed: fontSize 30px, line box 33.6px, letterSpacing -0.6px, weight 300.

sections.name: Post block — author row
sections.description: Striped placeholder avatar plus a single text line carrying the author name in ink and the relative age in muted grey. The age and name are one text run, not two columns.
sections.layout:
margin-top:16px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px.
  Avatar: width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:999px; background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#D9D2CA 0 3px,#E8E2DB 3px 6px) — 45° diagonal stripes, 3px band of #D9D2CA then 3px band of #E8E2DB, 6px period. No border, no shadow.
  Byline: font:400 13px/1.3 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#1B1917. Text "Mostafa H." then a nested <span style="color:#9A938C"> containing " · 6h ago" (leading space, U+00B7, space).

sections.name: Post block — body
sections.description: The full post text. Longest block on the screen; no truncation, no 'read more'.
sections.layout: margin-top:16px; font:400 15px/1.55 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#3D3833. Computed line box 23.25px. Note #3D3833 is a body-text ink not in the named palette — it is used ONLY for post body and comment body on this screen.

sections.name: Post block — engagement meta row
sections.description: Upvote affordance (the only stateful control on the screen) and a static comment count, separated from the body by a 1px inset top hairline. The comment count here is hard-coded '48 comments', matching the seed post record (comments: 48, line 978).
sections.layout:
margin-top:16px; padding-top:14px; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(27,25,23,.10) (a 1px top rule drawn INSIDE the box, full 358px width); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:18px; font:400 13px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#7A736D; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums.

  Like span (onClick={{p.toggleLike}}, style={{p.likeStyle}}): 'display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;cursor:pointer;transition:color 200ms ease-out;color:' + (liked ? '#E8621C' : '#7A736D'). Content is the single text node "▲ {{p.likeCount}}" — likeCount = 131 when not liked, 132 when liked. NOTE: gap:6px is declared but has no effect, because the ▲ and the number are one text node separated by an ordinary space, not two flex children. Reproduce the visual as "▲ 131" with a normal space.

  Comments span: no style of its own, inherits font:400 13px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic' and color:#7A736D from the row. Static text "48 comments". Not tappable.

sections.name: "Thread" section label
sections.description: Eyebrow label opening the comment section. Same eyebrow treatment used elsewhere in the app.

sections.name: Comment thread list
sections.description: Vertical list of comments. Nesting is expressed purely by a per-item wrap style supplied in the data (c.wrap), not by real tree structure — the list is flat and only one indent level exists in the seed data. Template declares hint-placeholder-count="3" but the seed array (lines 982-987) holds 4 items.
sections.layout:
Container: display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:20px. sc-for list={{comments}} as="c".

Per-item wrapper style comes from c.wrap:
  - Top-level items (index 0 "Nour S.", index 3 "Dalia K."): wrap = '' — no padding, no rail, full 358px.
  - Nested items (index 1 "Mostafa H.", index 2 "Hazem F."): wrap = 'padding-left:18px;box-shadow:inset 1px 0 0 rgba(27,25,23,.14)' — an 18px leading indent and a 1px vertical rail drawn inside the leading edge, spanning the full height of that comment block only (it does not run continuously between comments; the 20px gaps are unruled).

Inside every item:
  Header row: display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px.
    Avatar: width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:999px; background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#D9D2CA 0 3px,#E8E2DB 3px 6px) — identical gradient to the 34px post avatar, so the stripe pitch does NOT scale with the avatar.
    Byline: font:400 12px/1.3 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#1B1917, containing {{c.who}} then a nested <span style="color:#9A938C"> with " · {{c.ago}}" (note: comment ages render as bare "5h" with no "ago" suffix, unlike the post byline's "6h ago").
  Body: margin-top:8px; font:400 14px/1.55 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#3D3833.
  Action row: margin-top:8px; display:flex; gap:16px; font:400 11px/1 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; color:#9A938C; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums. Two spans: "▲ {{c.likes}}" and "Reply". Neither has an onClick, a cursor, or a hover/active style — both are static on this screen.

sections.name: Bottom spacer

sections.name: Composer bar (pinned overlay, isPost only)

position:absolute; left:16px; right:16px; bottom:104px; z-index:6; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; background:rgba(27,25,23,.58); backdrop-filter:blur(26px) saturate(180%); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(26px) saturate(180%); box-shadow:0 14px 32px rgba(27,25,23,.22), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.28) inset, 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.13); border-radius:999px; padding:12px 12px 12px 20px.

interactions: Screen entrance: the whole content column plays `bRise` — 240ms ease-out, opacity 0→1 and transform translateY(4px)→0. Applied once to the root, not staggered per child.

Back button (only interactive header control): onClick={{p.back}} → this.go(i, s.prev || fallback). For the Post detail phone the seed is mk('post','pit') with prev:null, so the fallback chain resolves to 'pit' — back goes to The Pit. Once you have navigated to this screen from elsewhere, s.prev holds the actual previous route. No press/ripple/active style is defined.

Ticker chip "SWDY ›": onClick={{p.goCompany}} = g('company') — called with NO nav argument, so the route changes to the Company screen while the bottom-nav highlight stays on whatever it was (Pit here). Worth mirroring: navigating to a company from a post does not move the tab selection.

Upvote toggle: onClick={{p.toggleLike}} flips state.liked. Visual change = text colour #7A736D → #E8621C with `transition:color 200ms ease-out`, and the count text 131 → 132. Nothing else changes — no scale, no glyph swap, no haptic, no fill.

Bookmark button, overflow (···) button, comment ▲ counts, comment "Reply" labels, the "48 comments" text, the composer field and the composer send button all have NO handlers and no cursor:pointer in this design. They are visual placeholders. Do not invent behaviour for them; if the product needs them, that behaviour is unspecified here.

Bottom nav: all four slots keep their onClick handlers on this screen (goHome/goMarket/goPit/goYou), each of which also sets nav, so tapping any of them replaces the Post detail route entirely. The Pit slot is the active one; its selection pill animates with `bPill` 320ms cubic-bezier(.32,1.2,.44,1) (opacity 0→1 only — the keyframe has no transform, the position is set statically by translateX(200%)).

No pressed/active state exists anywhere on this screen. For contrast: The Pit's floating compose button (line 753) does declare style-active="transform:scale(0.94)" with transition:transform 220ms ease-out — that is the house press treatment if you need one, but it is not applied to any Post detail control.
No scroll-linked behaviour is specified: the header row scrolls away with the content (it is in-flow, not sticky), and the composer/nav/scrim stay pinned regardless of scroll position.
flutterNotes:
STRUCTURE. Scaffold(extendBody: true) with a Stack: [scrolling content, scrim, composer, nav]. Content = SingleChildScrollView(padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 54, 16, 124)) wrapping a Column(crossAxisAlignment: start) with 18px gaps — use Column(spacing: 18) or interleave SizedBox(height: 18). Kill the scrollbar with ScrollConfiguration(behavior: …copyWith(scrollbars: false)). The 54px top pad is the mock's status-bar allowance; on device use max(MediaQuery.padding.top, 54) or keep 54 literal if you want pixel parity with the canvas. The header row is in-flow (scrolls away) — do NOT make it a SliverAppBar.

INSET SHADOWS ARE BORDERS, NOT SHADOWS. Flutter has no inset box-shadow. Translate: (a) kind chip `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(232,98,28,.55)` → Container(decoration: ShapeDecoration(shape: StadiumBorder(side: BorderSide(color: Color(0x8CE8621C), width: 1)))); (b) meta row `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(27,25,23,.10)` → Container(decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border(top: BorderSide(color: Color(0x1A1B1917), width: 1))), padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 14)); (c) nested comment `inset 1px 0 0 rgba(27,25,23,.14)` → Container(decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border(left: BorderSide(color: Color(0x241B1917), width: 1))), padding: EdgeInsets.only(left: 18)) — but see RTL below, this must become BorderDirectional(start:) with EdgeInsetsDirectional. Alpha conversions used: .08→0x14, .10→0x1A, .13→0x21, .14→0x24, .22→0x38, .26→0x42, .28→0x47, .30→0x4D, .55→0x8C, .58→0x94.

GLASS. Composer and nav both need ClipRRect(borderRadius: StadiumBorder-equivalent = BorderRadius.circular(999)) + BackdropFilter(ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 13, sigmaY: 13)) — CSS blur(26px) is a 26px radius ≈ sigma 13. `saturate(180%)` has no direct equivalent; approximate with ColorFilter.matrix on a saturation matrix composed into the same ImageFilter, or drop it and accept a slightly flatter glass. Fill Color(0x941B1917) over the blur. The 1px glass hairline rgba(255,255,255,.13) is a border, not a shadow — put it on the same ShapeDecoration. The `0 1px 0 inset` white sheen and `0 -8px 20px inset` bottom sheen need a hand-painted overlay (a 1px top LinearGradient sliver and a bottom vertical gradient inside the clip) — cheapest faithful approach is a CustomPaint layer inside the ClipRRect.

TYPOGRAPHY. CSS `font: W Spx/L` maps directly: TextStyle(fontWeight, fontSize: S, height: L) — Flutter `height` is a unitless multiplier exactly like CSS unitless line-height. letter-spacing em→px: -0.02em @30px = -0.6; .06em @10px = 0.6; .08em @13px = 1.04; .16em @11px = 1.76. font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums → fontFeatures: [FontFeature.tabularFigures()] on the meta row, comment action row and status bar. Load Outfit (300/400/500 used here) and IBM Plex Sans Arabic (400/500 used here) as bundled assets — a strict CSP/offline build cannot fetch Google Fonts. Set a global TextStyle with height applied per-widget; do not rely on Material defaults.

GLYPH RISK — READ THIS. The design leans on characters that Outfit and IBM Plex Sans Arabic may not cover: ‹ (U+2039), › (U+203A), ▲ (U+25B2 BLACK UP-POINTING TRIANGLE), ↑ (U+2191), ··· (U+00B7 ×3), … (U+2026). Verify each in the shipped font files. If ▲ or ↑ are missing you will get tofu — draw them instead (a 3-point Path for the triangle, Icons.arrow_upward for send) and hand-tune size to match a 13px/11px text run. Do not silently substitute Material icons for ‹ — its 300-weight Outfit form is thin and distinctive; a CustomPaint chevron is closer.

AVATAR GRADIENT. repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, #D9D2CA 0 3px, #E8E2DB 3px 6px) has no Flutter equivalent. Easiest faithful build: ClipOval + CustomPainter drawing 3px-wide bands at 45° across the bounds. Alternative: LinearGradient with tileMode: TileMode.repeated, GradientRotation(pi/4) and stops [0,0.5,0.5,1] — but you must compute begin/end so one period spans exactly 6px at that rotation, which differs between the 34px and 26px avatars. Note the design does NOT scale the stripe with the avatar: both sizes use the same 3px/6px pitch, so a CustomPainter parameterised in absolute px is the correct model.

ANIMATIONS. bRise → a 240ms Curves.easeOut FadeTransition + SlideTransition(Offset(0, 4/height) → Offset.zero), run once on route entry. Like toggle → AnimatedDefaultTextStyle(duration: 200ms, curve: Curves.easeOut) so the colour tweens; keep the count in the same Text so it swaps instantly (the design does not animate the number). bPill on the nav → 320ms Cubic(.32, 1.2, .44, 1) — that curve overshoots (y>1), so use Cubic directly, not Curves.easeOutBack.

LISTS. The comment thread is FLAT — indentation comes from a per-item `wrap` string in the data, not a tree. Model it as `List<Comment>` with an `int depth` (0 or 1 in the seed data) and render depth>0 with the indent+rail decoration. Do not build a recursive tree widget; the design has no affordance for depth ≥ 2 and no collapse/expand. Use a Column inside the scroll view (only 4 items) rather than a nested ListView.

HIT TARGETS. The 42px header buttons are just under the 44px guideline — wrap in a 44/48px GestureDetector with behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque without changing the painted 42px box. The like affordance is a 13px text run and "Reply"/"▲ n" are 11px runs: give them padding inside the tap target (or MaterialTapTargetSize.padded) — but the visual margins (gap 18px on the meta row, 16px in the comment actions) must stay exactly as specified, so expand the hit area outward with a Stack/Transform rather than adding padding that shifts layout.

RTL / ARABIC (direction-sensitive items — all must be mirrored):
• Back glyph ‹ must become › in RTL. Use Directionality to pick the glyph, or a mirrored CustomPaint.
• Ticker chip trailing chevron "SWDY ›" must lead-flip to "‹ SWDY" (or mirror the glyph); its letter-spacing .06em applies to a Latin ticker that stays LTR — wrap the ticker itself in Directionality(TextDirection.ltr) so "SWDY" never reorders inside an RTL run.
• Nested comment indent + rail: use EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start: 18) and BorderDirectional(start: …) so the rail lands on the right in Arabic.
• Composer padding is asymmetric (12/12/12/20, 20px on the leading side) → EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(20, 12, 12, 12). The ↑ send glyph is direction-neutral and must NOT be mirrored.
• Header row (back leading, actions trailing) mirrors automatically with Row + MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween under Directionality — no manual work, but verify.
• Bylines "Name · 6h ago" and "▲ 131": the ▲ prefix and the numeral must not get reordered by the bidi algorithm. Compose them as separate Text spans with explicit direction, or insert LRM/RLM marks. Digits: decide now whether Arabic locale uses Arabic-Indic numerals — if yes, tabular-nums behaviour must be re-verified in IBM Plex Sans Arabic.
• The bottom-nav selection pill uses transform:translateX(200%) — in RTL the slot order reverses, so compute the pill offset from the resolved slot index under Directionality, not from a hard-coded 200%.
• The avatar stripe angle (135deg) is cosmetic; mirroring it to 45deg in RTL is optional and not specified.

PRODUCT-RULE FLAGS (things the design leaves you exposed on):
• Colour-alone violation: the liked state is signalled ONLY by #7A736D→#E8621C on an unchanged "▲" glyph, and saveStyle likewise only inverts fill. That breaks the stated "verdict/state must never be communicated by colour alone" rule. Recommend a filled-vs-outlined triangle (or a weight/underline change) for liked, and a filled-vs-outline bookmark for saved, keeping the exact colours. Flag to design rather than shipping colour-only.
• Staleness labelling: every age string here is a pre-baked literal ("6h ago", "5h", "4h", "3h", "2h") in the seed data. In the real app these must be derived from an authoritative timestamp and re-rendered as time passes, not frozen at fetch time. The percentages inside the post body ("16.3%", "17.9%", "210bps", "40bps") are user-authored prose, not app data — do not style them as live figures and do not attach a freshness badge to them.
• Nothing on this screen introduces BUY/SELL/TARGET/STOP/EXPECTED RETURN semantics; the post-kind vocabulary is Question / Analysis / Source (from the seed data at lines 978-980). Keep it that way — the outlined-ember chip is a *kind* marker, not a signal.

NOT SPECIFIED (do not guess): dark mode for this screen (the canvas header claims "dark-first" but every value here is the light palette); pressed/hover/focus states for any Post detail control; composer focused/typing/keyboard-avoidance layout; comment pagination or a "load more" for the 48 comments when only 4 are shown; overflow-menu contents; empty/error/loading variants of this screen (the States screen at lines 696-751 covers generic ones, which I did not read); and any moderation UI beyond the "reported" state referenced in the States screen.
